law_record.title: Taxistands—Right turn after exiting
law_record.text: Any cab, upon leaving any stand designated in accordance with the provisions of this Section, shall execute a right-hand turn, when a sign is posted giving notice of this requirement, at the first street intersection after it leaves such stand.

activation_conditions: a sign is posted giving notice of the requirement
the subject leaves the designated taxicab stand
summary.subject: taxicab_operator

timing_requirements.requirement: the turn is owed at the first intersection after leaving the stand — the departure and that intersection must both be in the trace
'the first intersection' can only be identified over the whole stretch from the stand onward
